name: What Questions Should You Ask a Kitchen Remodel Contractor?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a kitchen remodeling contractor before signing a contract?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a kitchen remodeling contractor before signing a contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before signing, focus on questions that expose hidden risk. Ask exactly what is included in the scope, what is excluded, who handles permits, how inspections are scheduled, and how changes are priced. You should also ask how long similar kitchen projects typically take, what could delay your job, and whether the contractor uses in-house crews or subcontractors. It is also important to ask how communication works. Who is your daily contact? How often will you receive updates? How are selections approved? What happens if a material is delayed or a hidden condition is found after demolition? In Los Angeles County, these questions matter because schedule pressure and permit coordination can affect the entire project. Finally, ask for proof of insurance, recent local references, and a written warranty on workmanship. A serious contractor should welcome these questions and answer them directly. Vague answers early in the process usually become bigger problems once construction starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about scope, permits, schedule, payment terms, warranty, change orders, material allowances, subcontractors, cleanup, and who handles design decisions. Also confirm licensing, insurance, and recent kitchen-specific references. If the contractor cannot answer these clearly, the project is higher risk.
